title: TAS, VIC - Upgrade the Network
current_summary: An upstream provider will perform planned software updates on access network equipment affecting some services in Tasmania and Victoria. A brief interruption of up to 15 minutes is expected around 1:00 AM AEDT within the maintenance window from 12:00 AM to 6:00 AM AEDT on Tuesday, 13 October 2026. Services will be restored once the work is complete.

updates.content: Planned maintenance is scheduled in Tasmania and Victoria. Some customers may experience a brief loss of internet connectivity during the window from 12:00 AM to 6:00 AM AEDT on Tuesday, 13 October 2026. A single interruption of up to 15 minutes is expected around 1:00 AM AEDT. We are monitoring this work and will confirm once it is complete. If needed, you may wish to use mobile data as a backup during the brief outage. Thank you for your patience.
